title: Bobo's Red Ball
learning_objective: Recognize and identify the color red

story.beginning: Bobo is happily playing with his favorite ball in Happy Meadow.
story.problem: The red ball rolls away and Bobo cannot find it.
story.search: Bobo and Mimi look around the meadow and discover several colorful objects.
story.discovery: Mimi helps Bobo notice the red color among the other colors.
story.ending: Bobo finds his red ball and celebrates with Mimi.

educational_points: Compare red with other basic colors.
Repeat the word red several times.
Encourage children to find red objects around them.

shorts.title: Can Bobo Find His Red Ball?
